description: This bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of instilled preferences for two language models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, under three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The vertical axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences),” ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.25. The horizontal axis displays the two model categories, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, in order from left to right. For each model, three bars are grouped side-by-side: a gray bar representing the Control condition, a light blue bar for the Before Introspection Training condition, and a dark purple bar for the After Introspection Training condition. Error bars are present above each bar, indicating variability. For GPT-4o, the Control bar reaches approximately 0.20, the Before Training bar reaches approximately 0.60, and the After Training bar reaches approximately 0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control bar is near zero, the Before Training bar reaches approximately 0.40, and the After Training bar reaches approximately 0.75. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the model categories on the x-axis. The chart uses a legend in the top-left corner to associate each color with its corresponding condition.
